learning_outcomes.text: Ability to define metallurgical structures of welds
Understanding of gas metal reactions, effects of weld penetration and metal transfer ways
Classify welding methods, define and understanding of general working principles
Understanding of testing and inspection of welds
Ability to select proper electrode to welding
Ability to design weld joint and understanding of welding errors
Understanding of robotic welding and automation
Ability to apply common welding techniques practically
